Title: Facility Walkthrough Schedule
Description: Plan a schedule for routine facility walkthroughs across multiple locations
Prompt Text: Suggest a monthly walkthrough schedule for {{number}} facilities that balances frequency with staff availability, and explain the reasoning.

Title: Open Work Order Tracker
Description: Summarize open work orders from a SharePoint list into a status report
Prompt Text: Summarize the open items in {{SharePoint list name}} into a status report grouped by building and priority, calling out anything open more than 30 days.

Title: Facility Inspection Summary
Description: Summarize handwritten or typed inspection notes into a clean report
Prompt Text: Summarize the following facility inspection notes into a clean list of issues found, priority level, and recommended next steps: {{paste notes}}

Title: Building Safety Reminder
Description: Draft a reminder notice about a building safety procedure
Prompt Text: Draft a short, friendly reminder notice for staff about {{safety topic, for example fire drill procedures}}, including what to do and who to contact with questions.

Title: Facilities Work Order Request
Description: Draft a work order request describing a facilities issue
Prompt Text: Draft a clear work order request describing this issue: {{describe issue}}, including location, urgency, and any safety concerns.

Title: Grant Deadline Tracker
Description: Pull upcoming grant deadlines mentioned in email into a simple list
Display Prompt: List upcoming grant deadlines from my email
Prompt Text: Review my recent emails about {{grant program or funder name}} and list any deadlines or required deliverables mentioned, sorted by date.

Title: Procurement Follow-Up Email
Description: Draft a follow-up email to a vendor about a pending order or contract
Prompt Text: Draft a polite follow-up email to a vendor asking for a status update on {{order or contract name}} that was submitted on {{date}}.

Title: Vendor Proposal Comparison
Description: Compare multiple vendor proposal documents on key criteria
Prompt Text: Compare the proposals in {{document names or SharePoint folder}} on price, delivery timeline, and stated qualifications, and summarize the differences in a short table.

Title: RFP Summary
Description: Summarize a lengthy request for proposal into key requirements
Prompt Text: Summarize the following RFP into a short list of eligibility requirements, deadlines, and evaluation criteria: {{paste RFP text}}

Title: Grant Narrative Draft
Description: Draft a section of a grant application narrative
Prompt Text: Draft the need-statement section of a grant application for funding to support {{program or equipment}}, explaining the problem and why this funding would help.

Title: Budget Presentation Outline
Description: Turn a budget spreadsheet into a PowerPoint outline for leadership
Display Prompt: Turn this budget into a presentation outline
Prompt Text: Using the figures in {{Excel file name}}, create a PowerPoint outline with one slide per major budget category, summarizing the key numbers and trend for each.

Title: Vendor Invoice Summary
Description: Summarize a long or complex vendor invoice into key line items
Prompt Text: Summarize the following invoice into a short table of line items, quantities, and costs, and flag anything that looks unusual: {{paste invoice text}}

Title: Quarterly Spending Analysis
Description: Analyze a spending spreadsheet to identify trends and outliers
Prompt Text: Analyze the spending data in {{Excel file name}} and identify the top three categories driving the biggest change from last quarter, with a one-sentence explanation for each.

Title: Explain a Budget Variance
Description: Get a plain-language explanation of why actual spending differs from budget
Prompt Text: Explain in plain language why a line item might show a {{over or under}} variance of {{amount or percent}}, and suggest two or three likely causes to investigate: {{context}}

Title: Budget Justification Memo
Description: Draft a memo justifying a budget request
Prompt Text: Draft a one-page memo justifying a budget request of {{amount}} for {{purpose}}, including the business need and expected impact if approved.

Title: IT Policy Comparison
Description: Compare two versions of an IT policy stored in SharePoint to spot changes
Prompt Text: Compare {{document 1}} and {{document 2}} in SharePoint and list what changed between the two versions in plain language.

Title: SOP Draft from Notes
Description: Turn rough notes or a Teams conversation into a formatted standard operating procedure
Display Prompt: Turn these notes into an SOP
Prompt Text: Turn my rough notes on {{topic}} from {{Word document or Teams chat name}} into a formatted standard operating procedure with numbered steps and a when-to-escalate section.

Title: Help Desk Queue Summary
Description: Summarize open tickets from a shared mailbox or list into a priority overview
Prompt Text: Summarize the open items in {{shared mailbox or SharePoint list name}} into a short overview grouped by priority, with the oldest unresolved tickets called out first.

Title: Explain an Error Message
Description: Get a plain-language explanation of a technical error message for a help desk reply
Prompt Text: Explain the following error message in plain language a non-technical employee would understand, and suggest one or two first troubleshooting steps: {{paste error message}}

Title: System Outage Notice
Description: Draft a plain-language notice informing staff of a system outage or maintenance window
Prompt Text: Draft a clear, non-technical notice informing staff that {{system name}} will be unavailable from {{start time}} to {{end time}} for {{reason}}, including who to contact with questions.

Title: Vehicle Inspection Checklist
Description: Build a simple checklist for routine vehicle inspections
Prompt Text: Build a simple, printable checklist for a routine {{daily or weekly}} vehicle inspection covering the standard items an operator should check.

Title: Fleet Status Update
Description: Draft a status update email summarizing open fleet maintenance tickets from Teams or SharePoint
Prompt Text: Using the open maintenance tickets tracked in {{SharePoint list or Teams channel name}}, draft a short status update email for {{recipient}} summarizing what's in progress, completed, and delayed.

Title: Fleet Mileage Analysis
Description: Analyze a fleet mileage or fuel-usage spreadsheet for trends
Prompt Text: Analyze the mileage and fuel-usage data in {{Excel file name}} and identify the three vehicles with the highest usage this quarter, along with any notable trends.

Title: Maintenance Report Summary
Description: Summarize a lengthy vehicle maintenance or inspection report
Prompt Text: Summarize the following vehicle maintenance report into a short list of issues found, actions taken, and any follow-up needed: {{paste report text}}

Title: Vendor Inquiry Email
Description: Draft an email requesting a quote or status update from a fleet vendor
Prompt Text: Draft a professional email to a vendor requesting {{a quote for or status update on}} {{item or service}}, including a requested response date of {{date}}.

Title: Training Completion Reminder
Description: Draft a reminder email to staff who haven't completed required training, based on a tracking spreadsheet
Prompt Text: Using the completion status column in {{Excel file name}}, draft a reminder email to send to everyone marked Not Started for the {{training name}} course.

Title: Training Feedback Summary
Description: Analyze survey responses collected in Excel or Forms to identify recurring themes
Prompt Text: Analyze the training feedback responses in {{Excel file or Forms results name}} and summarize the top three recurring themes, both positive and areas for improvement.

Title: Simplify a Procedure
Description: Rewrite a complex procedure into simple, step-by-step language for new employees
Prompt Text: Rewrite the following procedure into clear, numbered steps that a new employee could follow without prior context: {{paste procedure text}}

Title: Training Quiz Questions
Description: Generate multiple-choice quiz questions to reinforce a training topic
Display Prompt: Create quiz questions on this topic
Prompt Text: Create five multiple-choice questions with answer keys to test understanding of {{training topic}}.

Title: Lesson Plan Outline
Description: Draft an outline for a training or team briefing lesson
Prompt Text: Draft a lesson plan outline for a {{duration}} training session on {{topic}}, including learning objectives, key discussion points, and a short knowledge check.
